roomSummary: A spacious open-plan living and dining space with dark carpeting, an adjoining hard-floored area at the rear right, a fireplace in the left foreground, and sliding doors opening onto an elevated deck.
camera: The camera stands in the living area foreground looking toward the sliding doors on the left, the rear wall with its central window, and the dining space on the right.

landmarks.description: Black-framed sliding glass doors leading to an outdoor timber deck on the far left
Full-length salmon curtains gathered beside the sliding door
Dark freestanding fireplace unit with stone tile hearth base in the left foreground
White ceiling fan with central light mounted in the middle of the ceiling
Window with exterior views on the back wall
Salmon curtains and sheer lace drapes flanking the back window
Distinct lighter-colored hard flooring section in the rear right corner

walls.name: Rear wall
walls.description: Off-white rear wall containing the sliding door frame, middle wall with small sconce, and rear window

walls.name: Right wall
walls.description: Plain white interior wall bounding the dining and living spaces on the right side

zones.name: Living Zone
zones.description: The carpeted central and foreground space between the fireplace hearth and the right side of the room

zones.name: Dining Zone
zones.description: The hard-floored area located at the rear right of the room beneath the rear window

layout.placement: Centered on the lighter hard flooring section at the rear right, aligned comfortably away from the rear and right walls
Centered on the dark carpet in the middle of the living space, directly under the ceiling fan
Placed on the central area rug facing toward the sliding doors and fireplace, leaving ample walking space behind it toward the dining area
Set on the area rug directly in front of the three-seater sofa
Angled on the near side of the area rug, facing toward the center of the living conversation area

relationships: The dining table stays entirely within the hard flooring section in the rear right.
The living room seating forms a cohesive conversation area on the carpeted floor, oriented to enjoy both the fireplace and the deck views.
A clear walking pathway remains open between the living zone and the sliding glass doors.
avoid: Do not block the sliding glass doors or impede access to the outdoor deck.
Do not place any furniture on or touching the stone fireplace hearth.
Do not spill dining furniture out of the hard flooring section into the main living circulation path.
keepUntouched: Black-framed sliding glass doors and outdoor deck railing
Freestanding fireplace unit and stone tile hearth
Rear window and its hanging salmon and lace curtains
